name: Travis CI API
tagline: REST API for Travis CI build status, jobs, and repository automation
description: Travis CI provides a REST API for CI/CD automation: query builds, jobs, logs, and repositories; trigger builds; manage settings. Primarily used with Travis CI.com for private/public repos. Auth via API token in Authorization header. Useful for agents integrating CI status into dashboards, bots, or release workflows.

auth.details: Authentication uses Authorization: token YOUR_API_TOKEN. Travis-API-Version: 3 is a separate required/recommended API version header, not an authentication alternative. Tokens from account settings.

pricing.paid_plans: Hosted plans from $15/mo (Bootstrap); Free Trial Plans currently unavailable per billing docs. Limited OSS/partner credits may exist under special conditions.

use_cases: get latest build status for a GitHub repository
list recent builds and jobs for a project
trigger a new Travis CI build for a branch
fetch build logs for a failed job
check if a repo is active on Travis CI
